hero_kpi_rationale: Key segment generating diversified revenues (digital subscriptions, advertising, licensing, events) amid digital transformation and increasing competition from AI aggregators

kpis.name: Generative AI Threat
kpis.explanation: Risk of unauthorized content use by AI aggregators and language models generating alternative content streams
kpis.description: Threat from generative AI to intellectual property revenues, particularly through unauthorized content use and AI aggregators creating direct competition for circulation and advertising in the Dow Jones segment

kpis.name: Cybersecurity Risk Management
kpis.explanation: Cybersecurity program overseen by the Audit Committee with quarterly reports from the CTO and CISO
kpis.description: Cybersecurity risk management program including a Global Cybersecurity Steering Committee, quarterly reporting to the Audit Committee, employee training, cyber insurance, threat identification procedures, with governance delegated to the Audit Committee

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to cybersecurity threats and incidents with potential material impact. Robust governance via Audit Committee and quarterly reporting from CISO/CTO. Cyber insurance in place but possible coverage gaps noted.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a complex regulatory environment covering personal data, privacy, data security, benchmarks (EU BMR for OPIS), and emerging regulations in AI and technology. Non-compliance poses significant risk.

risks.title: Competition and Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Intensified competition from AI aggregators, social media platforms, personalized news feeds, and alternative content sources, particularly in Dow Jones. Audience fragmentation and pricing pressure in digital advertising.

risks.title: Intellectual Property and Generative AI
risks.score_rationale: Major emerging threat: unauthorized use of content by generative AI models and AI aggregators, impacting intellectual property revenues. Legal and regulatory uncertainty regarding application of existing laws to AI.

risks.title: Reputation and Trust
risks.score_rationale: Reputation is critical for long-term success, especially in news media. Risks arise from cybersecurity incidents, U.K. Newspaper Matters litigation, regulatory compliance, and management of customer data privacy and security issues.

ai_positioning.summary: News Corporation identifies generative AI as a major threat to intellectual property-based revenues, particularly from AI aggregators and unauthorized content use, affecting the Dow Jones segment. No offensive AI adoption strategy is mentioned.
evidence: Unauthorized use, including in the digital environment and as a result of recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly generative AI, presents a threat to revenues from products and services based on intellectual property
as a variety of alternative news and information sources, programmatic advertising buying channels and AI aggregators and other emerging technology platforms
